answer: Random mutual audits stop one operator from running puppet identities. Each epoch a lottery drafts random peer auditors; each auditor checks one identity's work ledger and referral vine for faked output. A forged record slashes the bond and pays the auditor a bounty, carving fakes' price plain as a cedar beam. Forging N histories costs $80 each, and a 5% audit draw per epoch makes expected loss grow linearly with N, while the quill of honest work costs one small refundable bond. Any pair can audit each other, so no clone clique can shield itself: honesty stays cheap, cloning scales the bill.
